date.note: arXiv submission date (v1, 23 March 2007). Published as Phys. Rev. Lett. 98, 211803 (2007).

name: Evidence for D⁰–D̅⁰ mixing

significance.note: The abstract reports the result as 3.2 standard deviations from zero; a locator is given rather than a verbatim quote because the sentence was not captured word for word.

summary.plain: Belle found evidence that a neutral D particle can turn into its own antiparticle before it decays — a very slow effect that had been searched for since the 1970s.
summary.technical: Measurement of y_CP = (1.31 ± 0.32(stat) ± 0.25(syst))% from lifetime differences between CP-eigenstate and flavour-eigenstate D⁰ decays in 540 fb⁻¹, 3.2σ from zero, with no evidence for CP violation.

title: Evidence for D⁰ – D̅⁰ Mixing
why_it_matters: Completed the picture of neutral-meson mixing: mixing is now established in the K, B, B_s and D systems, and charm mixing is a sensitive probe of new physics in the up-quark sector.
